stemMd: A cube has vertices with coordinates 0 or 1. It is projected using u = (1,0), v = (0,1), w = (1,1). Which two distinct vertices have the same image?
explanationMd: The point (0,0,1) maps to w = (1,1). The point (1,1,0) maps to u + v = (1,1). This illustrates how a three-dimensional projection can superimpose distinct spatial points.
